title: Fixed Open Trough and Four Spring Vibratory Feeder
description: One newly authored whole empty fixed linear vibratory-feeder-style apparatus exterior. Four broad grounded soles and an open rectangular low frame support four complete exposed coarse coil-spring forms, each seated in full upper and lower discs. Two upper carriers hold a complete long open-front tray with a solid floor, outward-flared sides and one raised rear wall. Beneath the tray, two full separate transverse eccentric-motor-style housings have proud end covers and complete mounting saddles. No bowl, spiral track, mixing blade, belt, crop or bulk contents. This is not the previous circular spiral-bowl sorting feeder widened or a trough mixer emptied: the entire tray, spring, frame and paired underside-drive geometry is newly authored. One static model zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles. Springs are fixed closed art geometry, not elasticity or tuning. No vibration, motion, feed rate, bulk transport, powered mechanism, electrical, resonance, balance, isolation, bearing operation, load, engineering, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
